description: The Mopo project publishes hourly simulated wind and photovoltaic generation under four climate projections for pan-European energy-system modelling. Its own page names MPI-ESM1-2-HR and EC-Earth3, each with SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5, over 2015 to 2100. The scenarios retain three PV configurations, four offshore and nine onshore specific wind designs plus existing-plant configurations. Zenodo lists a public 12.6 GB ZIP under CC BY 4.0. These future resource profiles could test capacity plans, storage needs or cross-border dispatch under changing weather. They extend the separate historical Mopo VRE resource, not measuring future generation. Wind speeds are scaled using Global Wind Atlas 2, and climate-model and renewable-generation errors carry through to these outputs. The ZIP was not downloaded, so internal files, hourly completeness and exact spatial codes remain unverified. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this climate-projection release. Its size is recorded for access planning, not as evidence that calculations were reproduced.
